title: Shaking incubators and CO2 incubators (for new laboratory facility) | Lot 1: Shaking incubators, 2 units | Lot 2: Refrigerated shaking incubator, 1 unit | Lot 3: CO2 incubators, 9 units
description: The object of the procurement is the acquisition of incubators for laboratory use at Tampere University. The equipment will be placed at the Noodi research facility, which is being completed on Tampere University’s Hervanta campus. Noodi is Tampere University’s new hub for experimental research, bringing together advanced research facilities, modern learning environments and multidisciplinary collaboration in the fields of technology, medicine and information technology. The procurement is divided into three lots: two shaking incubators, one refrigerated shaking incubator, and nine CO2 incubators. Partial tenders are allowed. The equipment must meet the technical and functional requirements set out in the Call for Tenders, including CE conformity, compatibility with the 230 V electrical system used in Finland, and temperature, shaking and/or CO2 level control features suitable for laboratory use. The procurement includes delivery of the equipment to Tampere University’s Hervanta campus, to the Noodi research facility, and, depending on the lot, installation, commissioning, user manuals, technical support, warranty, and the availability of maintenance and repair services. Noodi is intended to provide modern and adaptable facilities for experimental research and to support research activities carried out by several faculties of Tampere University, including the Faculty of Medicine and Health Technology and the Faculty of Engineering and Natural Sciences. The indicative comparison price range for the procurement is EUR 150,000–180,000, excluding VAT. Two draft contracts are attached to the Call for Tenders: the MET draft contract and the ENS draft contract. The MET draft contract applies to Lot 1 and, in Lot 3, to eight units. The ENS draft contract applies to Lot 2 and, in Lot 3, to one unit. The draft contracts are substantially identical in terms of their contractual terms, but they differ with regard to the faculty representing the Customer, the invoicing details, and the Customer’s signatory. In the MET draft contract, the Customer is represented by the Faculty of Medicine and Health Technology, whereas in the ENS draft contract, the Customer is represented by the Faculty of Engineering and Natural Sciences. The General Terms of Public Procurement in Supply Contracts, JYSE 2025 Supplies, attached to the Call for Tenders, apply to both draft contracts as set out in the respective draft contracts. The object of Part 1 is the acquisition of two shaking incubators for laboratory use. The equipment must be CE compliant, compatible with the 230 V electrical system used in Finland, and suitable for use as independent benchtop models. The equipment must include, among other features, adjustable temperature control, orbital shaking motion, a timer function, an internal temperature display, a pull-out tray and an internal capacity of at least 50 litres. The procurement includes delivery to Tampere University’s Hervanta campus, user manuals, warranty, technical support, and the availability of maintenance and repair services. The indicative comparison price range for Part 1 is EUR 8,000–16,000, excluding VAT. The object of Part 2 is the acquisition of one refrigerated shaking incubator for laboratory use. The equipment must be CE compliant and compatible with the 230 V electrical system used in Finland. The incubator must include, among other features, orbital shaking, an adjustable operating temperature range, sufficient shaking speed and load capacity, stackability, a pull-out shaking platform, and platforms and attachments suitable for laboratory vessels of different sizes. The procurement includes delivery to Tampere University’s Hervanta campus, all parts required for operational readiness, possible installation, and warranty. The indicative comparison price range for Part 2 is EUR 26,000–30,000, excluding VAT. The object of Part 3 is the acquisition of nine CO2 incubators for laboratory use. The equipment must be CE compliant, compatible with the 230 V electrical system used in Finland, and stackable in stacks of two units of the same model. The equipment must include, among other features, an internal capacity of at least 140 litres, a touch screen, temperature and CO2 level control, HEPA filtration, heated sterilisation, humidity control, and structural features that support cleanability. The procurement includes delivery to Tampere University’s Hervanta campus, installation, commissioning, test runs, inspection and elimination of CO2 leakages, user manuals, warranty, technical support, and the availability of maintenance and repair services in Finland. The indicative comparison price range for Part 3 is EUR 100,000–115,000, excluding VAT.

description: Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue (Pohde) perustaa dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (DPS), jolla hankitaan tässä osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä kuvattuja tavaroita Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueelle. Hankintayksikkö kilpailuttaa hankinnat erillisillä DPS:n sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, joihin voivat osallistua järjestelmään hyväksytyt toimittajat. Hankintayksikkö hyväksyy järjestelmään kaikki osallistumishakemuksen jättäneet ehdokkaat, jotka täyttävät ehdokkaille asetetut soveltuvuusvaatimukset. DPS hankintamenettelynä on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnön liitteessä 1. Hankinnan kohteena ovat laserhoito- ja laserleikkauslaitteet sekä niihin liittyvät laitekohtaiset tarvikkeet, jotka soveltuvat eri erikoisalojen kirurgisiin ja polikliinisiin toimenpiteisiin. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on jaettu seuraaviin luokkiin: 1. Laserhoito- ja laserleikkauslaitteet sekä niihin liittyvät laitekohtaiset tarvikkeet silmäkirurgisiin ja polikliinisiin toimenpiteisiin 7. Laserhoito- ja laserleikkauslaitteet sekä niihin liittyvät laitekohtaiset tarvikkeet ihokirurgisiin ja polikliinisiin toimenpiteisiin 8. Uudet, innovatiiviset ja muut vastaavat laserhoito- ja laserleikkauslaitteet sekä niihin liittyvät laitekohtaiset tarvikkeet kirurgisiin ja polikliinisiin toimenpiteisiin, joita ei ole mainittu luokissa 1–7 Hankintayksiköllä on oikeus tarvittaessa hankkia laserhoito- ja laserleikkauslaitteita sekä niihin liittyviä laitekohtaisia tarvikkeita kirurgisiin ja polikliinisiin toimenpiteisiin myös dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän ulkopuolella, esimerkiksi erillisten kilpailutusten, suorahankintojen tai voimassa olevien sopimustensa perusteella, hankintalain puitteissa. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on voimassa 30.4.2032 saakka, ellei sitä erillisellä ilmoituksella lyhennetä tai pidennetä. title: Ireland – Installation services of meteorological equipment – Upgrade of Met Éireann's Satellite Observation Handling System
description: Met Éireann, Ireland’s National Meteorological Service, looks to upgrade its satellite observation handling system. It currently receives satellite meteorology data from the EUMETCast Satellite dissemination service using an antenna-based reception system at its headquarters in Dublin. Met Éireann is also in the process of establishing additional connections to the EUMETCast Terrestrial service at both its headquarters and a second data centre in Dublin, to increase resilience and redundancy in its satellite data supply. The primary aim of this procurement is to upgrade Met Éireann’s satellite observation handling system to ensure continuity of data supply, capacity for higher data rates and new data types from next-generation satellites, and to increase the resilience and geo-redundancy of this important data source. This procurement looks to achieve the following: -Obtain system layout and design guidance for an upgraded satellite reception and processing system; -Procure hardware components to facilitate the reception and processing of current and next-generation meteorological satellite observations by the satellite system. The key hardware components shall include two antenna-dish receivers, six DVB units and required cabling. Complete component requirements will be finalised based on the system design agreed upon with the Contractor; -Procure service for the replacement/installation of required hardware for new system; -Procure the required software for the handling and processing of satellite observations on the reception and processing servers, and the installation of this software; -Procure service to test and commission the new system to receive and process data from EUMETCast dissemination services; -Ensure processed data outputted by the new system is compatible with Met Éireann’s visualisation and assimilation systems; -Procure maintenance and service plan to cover the new system once operational. With an increase in satellite data rates expected within 2024, the capacity of the supplier to perform the replacement of the system within a short time frame will be an important element.

title: BAW 16/2023 Bereitstellung von Lizenzen des Herstellers Autodesk
description: Die BAW verwendet seit Jahren in den verschiedensten Bereichen die Produkte 3ds Max, Auto-CAD Fusion 360 und Inventor Professional. Unter anderem werden die Produkte für folgende Anforderungen eingesetzt: CAM Tool für CNC Fräse (Bahnplanung). Erstellen von 3D Modellen. Erstellen von technischen Zeichnungen z.B. für CE-Zertifizierungen und Auftragsarbeiten. 3D Druck Auftragsvorbereitung. eCAD Anwendungen. Das Erstellen von Schaltpläne und Platinenlayout. Zur Erstellung von Sichtmodellen für das Sichtsystem des Schiffsführungssimulators. Konstruktion von Teilen und Baugruppen für den Einbau von Sensorik auf Messschiffen. Die BAW benötigt z.B. AutoCAD für 3D-Konstruktionen von Baugruppen um Bauraumanalysen durchführen zu können. Andere in der BAW eingesetzten CAD-Systeme sind hierfür nur eingeschränkt geeignet, da diese entweder auf eine Anwendung im GIS- oder im Architekturumfeld abzielen. Auch für den Datenaustausch von Maschinenbaufertigungsteilen wie z.B. Schleusentore, Wehrverschlüsse etc. mit der WSV werden verstärkt Inventor-Dateien verwendet. Um die vielfältigen Anforderungen abzudecken setzt die BAW folgende Mietlizenzen ein. 1x 3ds max, 3x AutoCAD, 6x Fusion 360, 4x Inventor Professional. Um auch zukünftig flexibel auf die unterschiedlichsten Anforderungen der Lizenznutzung reagieren zu können, soll ein Rahmenvertag über die zeitlich befristete Überlassung von von Auto-desk® Lizenzen abgeschlossen werden. Der Abruf von Lizenzen wird bedarfsorientiert über einen EVB-IT Erstellungsvertrag Typ B erfolgen. Eine garantierte Abnahmemenge von Lizenzen ist nicht vorgesehen. Aus diesem Grund ist der Rahmenvertrag so ausgestaltet, dass Rabattsätze auf die Herstellerpreisen angegeben werden müssen. Diese Rabattsätze hat der Bieter in einem separaten Dokument (siehe 4 (07)) einzureichen. Darüber hinaus sollen optional Leistungen für einen Anwendersupport, evtl. inklusive Schulungen vereinbart werden.
